description: Commission of Elections - The list of Political Parties entitled to be recognized for the purpose of Elections
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under Section 7(4)(b) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, published by the Election Commission. Its primary purpose is to publish the official list of political parties recognized for election purposes. This directly relates to electoral processes and candidate/party registrations, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7). Although it names the Election Commission members, this is incidental to the main electoral function of the notice, and there are no government personnel appointments or structural changes that would trigger a government-related classification.
